fullPassage: We cannot make sense of the facts of the past unless they are embedded in stories of agents negotiating the world. These stories must connect actors' goals, desires, and intentions to their experiences, and ultimately to their actions and interactions with others. When historical records can be fit neatly into one story, they seem to make sense. But problems arise when the same records could fit equally well into two or more different narratives. When this happens, what used to seem like a clear explanation becomes _______________. In other words, the very same records that looked like solid evidence for one story can just as easily be used to support a completely different one. This doesn't mean historical records are useless — it means their meaning depends on the narrative framework within which they are placed.

These stories must connect actors' goals, desires, and intentions to their experiences, and ultimately to their actions and interactions with others. When historical records can be fit neatly into one story, they seem to make sense. But problems arise when the same records could fit equally well into two or more different narratives. When this happens, what used to seem like a clear explanation becomes _______________. In other words, the very same records that looked like solid evidence for one story can just as easily be used to support a completely different one. This doesn't mean historical records are useless — it means their meaning depends on the narrative framework within which they are placed.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 they가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
(문맥: "...it means <u>their</u> meaning depends on the narrative framework within which <u>they</u> are placed.")

det.korean: they = historical records. 앞 문장 'This doesn't mean historical records are useless'의 주어를 받는다.
det.analysis:
① 과거의 사실들 — facts of the past이지 이 문장의 선행사가 아님
② 행위자들의 이야기 — stories이지 이 문장의 선행사가 아님
③ 역사적 기록들 — historical records를 바로 받는 대명사 ←정답
④ 서로 다른 서사들 — different narratives이지 이 문장의 선행사가 아님
det.tip: 'historical records are useless — it means their meaning...they are placed' → they = historical records.
